name: Smart Duplicate Post & Page
author: Ayush Guleria

sections.description:
Smart Duplicate Post & Page is a lightweight and powerful WordPress plugin that allows you to clone posts, pages, and custom post types instantly.
Whether you’re a blogger, developer, or website administrator, this plugin saves you time by quickly creating identical copies of existing content without losing SEO settings, metadata, or formatting.

This plugin is perfect for anyone who wants to:
– Create multiple copies of similar pages
– Speed up website development and content creation
– Preserve SEO-optimized structures and layouts

With a clean, user-friendly interface, Smart Duplicate Post & Page integrates seamlessly into your WordPress dashboard for a one-click duplication experience.

Features

  • One-click duplication for posts, pages, and custom post types
  • Preserves all content including title, content, images, custom fields, and SEO metadata
  • Works with Gutenberg, Classic Editor, and page builders like Elementor, Divi, and Beaver Builder
  • Supports all registered post types (e.g., products, portfolios, testimonials, etc.)
  • Allows duplication of drafts, published posts, private posts, and scheduled posts
  • Fully compatible with any WordPress theme
  • Lightweight, fast, and optimized for performance
  • No coding skills required — designed for beginners and professionals alike
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/smart-duplicate-post-page directory, or install the plugin via the WordPress Plugins screen.
  2. Activate the plugin from the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Go to your Posts or Pages list.
  4. Hover over the desired item and click Duplicate to create an exact copy instantly.
sections.faq:
Does it copy custom fields and metadata?

Yes, the plugin duplicates all custom fields, SEO metadata, featured images, and other associated content.

Does it work with custom post types?

Absolutely! It supports all registered custom post types, including WooCommerce products.

Will it duplicate drafts, private posts, and scheduled content?

Yes, it works with all post statuses. The duplicated copy will be saved as a draft by default.

Is this plugin compatible with page builders?

Yes, it works perfectly with Elementor, Divi, WPBakery, Beaver Builder, and other major builders.

Does the plugin affect website speed?

No, the plugin is lightweight and optimized for performance.
